name: Streaming · Football scoreboard (Flask + Preact)
description: Real-time football scoreboard for broadcast: Flask and Socket.IO backend, Preact overlay frontend, multi-room architecture, and tested WebSocket contracts.
longDescription: Dual-runtime scoreboard for streaming: a Python Flask server with Socket.IO handles rooms, timers, and assets; a Preact SPA renders overlay scenes for OBS. Supports multiple fields, sponsor rotation, penalty boards, and intro sequences. The operator dashboard is separated from the technical panel for clearer match-day workflows. Modular WebSocket hooks and shared test fixtures keep backend and frontend aligned. Optional packaging produces standalone executables for venue operators.
features: Multi-room realtime architecture for parallel matches
Responsive overlay components for scoreboard, sponsors, and penalties
Connected sponsor bar with dynamic rotation
Split operator dashboard and technical panel layouts
Modular WebSocket layer with automated overlay tests
Packaging helpers for distributable venue builds
OBS and Streamlabs oriented layout defaults
highlights: Clear split between realtime server and lightweight overlay UI
Designed for multi-match venues with parallel fields
Test coverage on overlay behaviour and socket contracts
challenges: Python and JavaScript stacks must agree on schema evolution when OBS reloads browser sources.
solutions: Socket.IO rooms, documented event payloads, resilient client bootstrapping, and shared test fixtures.
security: Run the server behind TLS on production networks
Authenticate control endpoints if exposed outside trusted LANs
